lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Alberta says Supreme Court decision on Quebec a win for provincial lawmakers, The Canadian Press reports.

Shoppers migrated from Thanksgiving meals to Black Friday deals as predictably as migrating geese heading south for winter, testing weather that had delayed the Macy’s parade in New York and generated flood alerts in Southern Califo, The Associated Press reports.
CRTC says Bell, Telus and Rogers violated its ban on junk fees, The Canadian Press reports.
Zelenskyy urges U.S. to pressure Putin and questions Trump’s reference to Putin as a ‘friend’, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
